'''Ithoon''' was the sixth [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="FS" /><ref name="CE" /> [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Centares (star)|Centares]] in the [[Centares system/Legends|Centares system]],<ref name="TT" /> located in the [[Maldrood sector/Legends|Maldrood sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim Territories]].<ref name="CE" /><ref name="EAOC" /> Ithoon had three [[Moon/Legends|moons]]<ref name="TT" /><ref name="CE" /> and was a barren ball of rock.<ref name="CE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ithoon was first introduced in "[[Triplet Threat]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] mini-adventure written by [[Jason Fry]] for use with [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[January 22]], [[2004]].<ref name="TT" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently placed the Centares system, and therefore Ithoon, in grid square R-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
